mapper.select:
SELECT sa.id, sa.similar_score, sa.live_average_uv, sa.follower_count, sa.live_average_user, sa.live_average_amount, sa.total_amount, sa.live_total_amount_cmm_ind, sa.live_count, sa.live_average_online, sa.author_id, sa.unique_id, sa.sec_uid, sa.collect_date, sa.anchor_name, sa.anchor_avatar, sa.account_heat, sa.total_amount_numeric, sa.create_date, sa.update_date, sa.is_deleted FROM tb_similar_anchor sa INNER JOIN tb_hot_search_trade_ranking_list sc ON sa.id = sc.similar_anchor_id
join tb_anchor_url as au on sc.system_anchor_id = au.id and au.platform = 0 join tb_anchor_crux_words_rela as acwr on acwr.sec_uid = au.sec_uid and acwr.is_deleted = 0 join tb_anchor_crux_words as acw on acwr.keyword_id = acw.id and acw.is_deleted = 0
INNER JOIN tb_trade t ON sc.trade_id = t.id WHERE sc.trade_id = #{tradeId} and sc.up_ranking = 1 AND t.rank_enabled = 1 AND sc.is_deleted = 0 AND sa.is_deleted = 0 AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND sa.update_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND acw.keyword = #{liveKeyword}
AND sa.anchor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{anchorName}, '%')
ORDER BY sc.weight_score DESC, source_type desc
